scannerComparison.scoringRule: A file is CORRECT only when the mapped episode exists in the assigned season. metadata.type==="special" is Seanime fallback for "franchise matched, episode number did not fit", so it is scored against the season episode count too; type "nc" (creditless) counts as correct.
scannerComparison.headline: Seanime 82.3% correct with ZERO wrong matches vs Study OS best case 50.0% with 31 wrong matches.
scannerComparison.structuralReason: Seanime resolves seasons and converts absolute episode numbers to season-relative. Verified: The Big O split across AniList 567 (files 01-13) and 129608 (14-26 as eps 1-13); SPYxFAMILY abs 48-50 -> S3 eps 10-12; Frieren abs 35 -> S2 ep 7. Study OS has no season model, so every file lands on season 1.
scannerComparison.caveat: Jikan returned HTTP 504 throughout, so Study OS fell back to AniList (its designed behaviour). The Jikan primary was never exercised.
studyOsBugsFound: parseMediaFileName never normalises underscores: AnimePahe_X_-_01_1080p.mp4 -> kind=unknown, episode=null, episode number baked into seriesKey -> category inbox -> dropped before any provider lookup (33/62 files).
Release-source prefix not stripped: anilistSearch("AnimePahe Gnosia") returns 0 candidates; all 15 AnimePahe series scored 0.00 for this reason alone.

adopted.hardestFailure: atomWithStorage(..., {getOnInit:true}) snapshots localStorage at module-eval, so a token written from a React effect is too late -> silent 401 -> location.replace("/public/auth") -> blank screen with no console error. Hence src/media/seanimeBootstrap.ts.

cuePatch.deviation: Dispatches from timeupdate/seeked, NOT from onSubtitleEvents()/_recordSubtitleEvent() as originally planned — those run at demux time, ahead of playback, so a dispatch there means "a cue was parsed", not "a cue is on screen".
cuePatch.runtimeProof: NOT PERFORMED — needs the player mounted against a mediastream session, which is Phase-3 surface Phase 2 deliberately excluded. Cue semantics are unproven at runtime; see patches/seanime/README.md for the three assumptions to check.
